**Clamp clip frame durations to the segment boundary and use the emitted end for the FPS slot.** `nextSlot` limits timestamp spacing, but `videoSource.add` receives the untrimmed decoded duration. A frame returned before `sourceEnd` can therefore extend into the next clip or slide. Audio advances at the exact segment boundary, so this can show the previous clip while the next segment's audio is playing.
Suggested fix
```diff - if (minFrameGap > 0) nextSlot = outTs + minFrameGap; + const segmentEnd = segment.timelineStart + segment.duration; + const frameDuration = Math.min( + Math.max(wrapped.duration, minFrameGap), + segmentEnd - outTs, + ); + if (frameDuration <= 0) continue; + if (minFrameGap > 0) nextSlot = outTs + frameDuration; compose.clip(wrapped.canvas, wrapped.timestamp, wrapped.duration, outTs); if (framer && view) framer.frame(view, preset.framing === "fill" ? "fill" : "fit"); await sendPosterOnce(); - await videoSource.add(outTs, Math.max(wrapped.duration, minFrameGap)); + await videoSource.add(outTs, frameDuration); ```
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion // fps cap: drop frames before the next slot. The kept frame's sample lasts until // the next kept one (the muxer derives durations from timestamp deltas), so // timestamps stay monotonic and the timeline length is unchanged. if (nextSlot !== null && outTs < nextSlot - 1e-6) continue; const segmentEnd = segment.timelineStart + segment.duration; const frameDuration = Math.min( Math.max(wrapped.duration, minFrameGap), segmentEnd - outTs, ); if (frameDuration <= 0) continue; if (minFrameGap > 0) nextSlot = outTs + frameDuration; compose.clip(wrapped.canvas, wrapped.timestamp, wrapped.duration, outTs); if (framer && view) framer.frame(view, preset.framing === "fill" ? "fill" : "fit"); await sendPosterOnce(); // Use the frame's own decoded duration so clip frames preserve the // source's native cadence without rounding to a fixed grid. await videoSource.add(outTs, frameDuration); ```
